title: Buttons
statementMd:
Manao is trying to open a rather challenging lock. The lock has $*n*$ buttons on it and to open it, you should press the buttons in a certain order to open the lock. When you push some button, it either stays pressed into the lock (that means that you've guessed correctly and pushed the button that goes next in the sequence), or all pressed buttons return to the initial position. When all buttons are pressed into the lock at once, the lock opens.

Consider an example with three buttons. Let's say that the opening sequence is: {2, 3, 1}. If you first press buttons 1 or 3, the buttons unpress immediately. If you first press button 2, it stays pressed. If you press 1 after 2, all buttons unpress. If you press 3 after 2, buttons 3 and 2 stay pressed. As soon as you've got two pressed buttons, you only need to press button 1 to open the lock.

Manao doesn't know the opening sequence. But he is really smart and he is going to act in the optimal way. Calculate the number of times he's got to push a button in order to open the lock in the worst-case scenario.

## Input

A single line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$) — the number of buttons the lock has.

## Output

In a single line print the number of times Manao has to push a button in the worst-case scenario.

## Note

Consider the first test sample. Manao can fail his first push and push the wrong button. In this case he will already be able to guess the right one with his second push. And his third push will push the second right button. Thus, in the worst-case scenario he will only need 3 pushes.
statementZhMd:
Manao 正在尝试打开一把颇具挑战性的锁。锁上有 $*n*$ 个按钮。要打开锁，你需要按照某个特定顺序按下这些按钮。当你按下某个按钮时，它要么保持按下状态（这意味着你猜对了，并且按下的是序列中的下一个按钮），要么所有已经按下的按钮都会恢复到初始位置。当所有按钮同时处于按下状态时，锁就会打开。

考虑一个有三个按钮的例子。假设打开顺序是：{2, 3, 1}。如果你首先按下按钮 1 或 3，按钮会立即弹回。如果你首先按下按钮 2，它会保持按下状态。如果你在按下按钮 2 后按下按钮 1，所有按钮都会弹回。如果你在按下按钮 2 后按下按钮 3，按钮 3 和 2 会保持按下状态。一旦你已经有两个按钮处于按下状态，就只需要按下按钮 1 即可打开锁。

Manao 不知道打开顺序。但他非常聪明，会采取最优策略。请计算在最坏情况下，他需要按下多少次按钮才能打开锁。

## 输入格式

一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$）——锁上的按钮数量。

## 输出格式

一行输出 Manao 在最坏情况下需要按下按钮的次数。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。Manao 第一次按下按钮时可能失败，按下错误的按钮。在这种情况下，他第二次按下时就已经能够猜中正确的按钮了。第三次按下将按下第二个正确的按钮。因此，在最坏情况下，他只需要按下 3 次按钮。
